question: Which of the following Indian Olympians has written the autobiography titled ‘Playing to Win’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saina Nehwal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Saina Nehwal, India’s star badminton player and World Number 4, Padma Shri and Khel Ratna awardee.
 
• She is the girl who brought laurels to India by winning an Olympic medal at the age of twenty-two.
 
 
• In "Playing to Win", she talks about her childhood and growing–years; her relationship with the most important people in her life; the ups and downs of her celebrated career, from district-level wins to the Olympics; and the sacrifices needed to succeed in any sport.
 
• She also reveals little-known facts and offers a peek into her many avatars—daughter, sister, student, and the regular girl behind the badminton prodigy.
 
• This book reveals what a typical day in Saina’s life is like—rigorous training, a strict diet, and no parties or sleepovers.
 
• It's not all work and no play; Saina loves to shop, eat ice cream (post wins only), and play games on her iPad.
 
• With candid photographs and badminton tips from the pro herself, this book showcases the making of a badminton champ—in her own words.
